title: Boss Overview
description: Multi-cluster boss heartbeats and health. Shows all registered boss agents across clusters with current status, lag, and resource metrics.

panels.title: Boss Heartbeat Lag
panels.description: Current heartbeat lag per boss. Shows the latest heartbeat for each boss_id with status (OK < 60s, WARN 60-120s, DOWN > 120s).

targets.query:
SELECT
  boss_id,
  cluster,
  timestamp,
  dateDiff('second', timestamp, now()) AS lag_seconds,
  docker_running,
  docker_total,
  disk_used_pct,
  if(lag_seconds > 120, 'DOWN', if(lag_seconds > 60, 'WARN', 'OK')) AS status
FROM boss_heartbeats
WHERE (boss_id, timestamp) IN (
  SELECT boss_id, max(timestamp)
  FROM boss_heartbeats
  GROUP BY boss_id
)
ORDER BY cluster

panels.title: Active Bosses (Last 2 min)
panels.description: Number of unique boss agents that reported a heartbeat in the last 2 minutes

targets.query: SELECT count(DISTINCT boss_id) FROM boss_heartbeats WHERE timestamp > now() - 120

panels.title: Total Docker Containers
panels.description: Total Docker containers across all clusters (from most recent heartbeat per boss)

targets.query: SELECT sum(docker_total) FROM boss_heartbeats WHERE timestamp > now() - 120

panels.title: Disks Above 85%
panels.description: Number of bosses with disk usage above 85% threshold

targets.query: SELECT count(DISTINCT boss_id) FROM boss_heartbeats WHERE disk_used_pct > 85 AND timestamp > now() - 120

panels.title: Running Containers per Cluster
panels.description: Docker containers running per cluster over time

targets.query:
SELECT
  timestamp,
  cluster,
  sum(docker_running) AS running
FROM boss_heartbeats
GROUP BY timestamp, cluster
ORDER BY timestamp

panels.title: Heartbeat Timeline
panels.description: Raw heartbeat events over time, colored by boss_id. Gaps indicate a boss stopped reporting.

targets.query:
SELECT
  timestamp,
  boss_id,
  docker_running
FROM boss_heartbeats
ORDER BY timestamp

panels.title: Disk Usage Trend
panels.description: Disk usage percentage per boss over time

targets.query:
SELECT
  timestamp,
  boss_id,
  disk_used_pct
FROM boss_heartbeats
ORDER BY timestamp

panels.title: Load Average (1m)
panels.description: System load average per boss over time

targets.query:
SELECT
  timestamp,
  boss_id,
  load_1m
FROM boss_heartbeats
ORDER BY timestamp
